title: Private typed-action provenance canary v2
summary: Replace the rejected broad action-trace spine with a private, single-invocation, deterministic child-stub and pure-mock CPU canary whose only eventual claim is exact prospective byte binding across one request, one response envelope, one structured parse decision, one private transition, and one atomic six-record trace.
system_thesis: The project thesis remains that a recurrent agent may eventually learn prospectively from its own lived thoughts, actions, outcomes, corrections, dreams, and low-rank consolidation. This candidate does not instantiate or test that thesis. It isolates one prerequisite: a causally ordered, typed-action provenance receipt that is exact enough to support later separately ratified experiments without reconstructing action authority from prose or incomplete legacy traces.

nodes.before: No ratified private canary-v2 contract exists.
nodes.after: A future exactly ratified contract may freeze the six closed record schemas, canonical bytes, manifests, successful and rejected fixtures, resource bounds, stable failures, and PC1-PC9 registry.
nodes.rationale: Post-ratification implementation must execute exact approved bytes rather than fill semantic gaps.

nodes.before: No v2 writer exists or is authorized.
nodes.after: A future single-writer CPU component may prospectively append and fsync exactly six canonical records, validate, atomically rename without replacement, and directory-fsync one private committed ledger.
nodes.rationale: Prospective durability is the causal-order substrate; partials remain quarantined non-evidence.

nodes.after: A future deterministic source-bound child stub may consume exactly one canonical request and emit exactly one closed response envelope with runtime receipts.
nodes.rationale: A stub isolates byte provenance without pretending to establish real model consumption or intent.

nodes.after: A future parser may consume only the frozen structured tool-channel bytes and deterministically emit ACCEPTED plus one authorized dispatch request or REJECTED plus no dispatch.
nodes.rationale: Effect authority must derive from a structured channel, never assistant prose.

nodes.after: A future pure in-memory total function may recompute the frozen private transition and exact reduced rational score, with no filesystem, network, subprocess, device, or external effect.
nodes.rationale: The pure mock makes single-file durability locally honest without claiming real-tool atomicity.

nodes.before: No v2 validation or evidence receipt exists.
nodes.after: Two future source-distinct CPU validators, a comparator, and a canonical evidence binder may validate registered immutable fixtures without importing canary implementation helpers.
nodes.rationale: A committed ledger alone is engineering output; the narrow claim requires independently recomputed relational evidence.

nodes.before: The rejected spine proposed a private-to-public result projector and declassification surface.
nodes.after: Absent from this canary: one private root only and no public projection, declassifier, public consumer, or secrecy claim.
nodes.rationale: Delete unresolved surfaces instead of disguising them as validated by a plumbing canary.

nodes.before: The rejected spine proposed context admission, recurrence, and future consumers of public action outcomes.
nodes.after: Absent from this canary: no prior outcome, recurrence, recall, parent, dream, sleep, adapter, evaluator, benchmark, report consumer, or future writeback.
nodes.rationale: A single-invocation canary has no lawful feedback edge or successor context.

edges.after: The writer may read only exact ratified schemas, fixtures, manifests, and limits.
edges.rationale: Prevents implementation from defining normative bytes after approval.

edges.after: Only after INVOCATION_PREPARED is durably fsynced may the exact child_request_bytes be delivered once.
edges.rationale: Binds invocation provenance and operation order.

edges.after: Only after CHILD_RESPONSE_RECEIVED is durably fsynced may the parser consume the exact raw_tool_channel_bytes extracted from its closed envelope.
edges.rationale: Binds parsing to the structured response channel and makes prose inert.

edges.after: Only an fsynced ACCEPTED parse with a recomputable authorization hash yields one dispatch; REJECTED deterministically yields no execution.
edges.rationale: Makes the typed parser decision the sole action authority.

edges.after: The pure mock returns a recomputable private receipt; only EXECUTED_VALID or the exact nonexecuted rejection path may receive a legal close.
edges.rationale: Invalid synthetic receipts can be tested but never published as observations.

edges.after: After close and file fsync, both independent validators must accept exact bytes before no-replace publication; the evidence binder separately binds the committed file and validation outputs.
edges.rationale: Separates artifact publication from evidence eligibility.

edges.before: The prior proposal contained public-result and future-context edges.
edges.after: No result leaves the private canary and no output is admitted to a future context, corpus, adapter, evaluator, or report.
edges.rationale: The canary establishes local provenance only, not information-flow security or recurrence.

loops.after: Exactly one open, one prepared invocation, one received response, one parse decision, one valid private dispatch or non-dispatch receipt, one close, dual validation, atomic publication, and separate evidence binding.
loops.trigger: After a future releasable consensus, exact human ratification, and supervisor revalidation of the exact sorted CPU stub/mock scope; never from this proposal alone.
reads: exact ratified contract, schemas, manifests, fixtures, oracle, limits, and PC1-PC9 registry
writes: one private six-record partial or committed JSONL artifact
two independent validator outputs and comparator output
one canonical evidence receipt after successful validation
loops.stop_condition: Terminate after one valid committed SUCCESS or REJECTED trace and bound evidence receipt; any invalid transition, budget violation, crash, validation disagreement, stale byte, or publication error yields no eligible claim artifact.
loops.rationale: A total bounded lifecycle is auditable without importing the broad spine's recurrence and capability ambiguity.

loops.before: The project ultimately contemplates repeated think/action/outcome/dream/sleep/adapter cycles.
loops.after: Absent: no prior outcome, recurrence, retry, future context, parent, dream, sleep, training, adapter, evaluation, report, or feedback edge.
loops.rationale: A plumbing canary cannot be credited as a learning loop.

claims.before: No prospective typed-action provenance claim is supported.
claims.after: Maximum future claim: in the registered deterministic-stub/private-mock fixture, the committed six-event trace prospectively bound one exact child request and response to one offered typed-tool schema, one parser decision, and one recomputable pure private transition under the registered byte, lifecycle, durability, and resource checks.
claims.evidence_needed: Exact ratification; scoped implementation; PC1-PC9; immutable committed trace; source-distinct validator agreement; comparator; complete canonical evidence receipt; and fresh independent audit.

claims.before: A broad trace might be misread as evidence that a model consumed a prompt, intended an action, learned, improved, remembered, or safely interacted with a real tool.
claims.after: Forbidden. The canary establishes none of model truth, intent, reasoning, learning, behavior, memory, secrecy, noninterference, real-tool atomicity, recurrence, consolidation, benchmark performance, or Experience Models efficacy.
claims.evidence_needed: Each broader claim requires a new material change with its own exact runtime receipts, controls, deliberation, human ratification, independent audit, and when applicable GPU gate.

acceptance_tests.setup: After exact ratification only, construct the one registered successful six-record fixture and one registered rejected/non-dispatched fixture under the frozen contract.
acceptance_tests.expected: Both source-distinct validators reproduce every byte, record and parent hash, parser status, transition or non-dispatch, terminal count, stable status, and evidence binding exactly.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Any mismatch falsifies the canary's total fixture closure and blocks publication and the narrow claim.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Future immutable PC1 validator outputs, comparator output, fixture hashes, committed canary hashes, and evidence receipt.

acceptance_tests.setup: Mutate offered schema, structured config, child request, received-request hash, JSON pointer, raw envelope, raw channel, parser input, parsed call, canonical arguments, action names/opcodes, and dispatch bytes individually.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every registered mutation is rejected at its exact first applicable stable phase by both validators.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Any accepted mutation falsifies byte binding from offered schema through dispatch.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Future immutable PC2 mutation registry and dual-validator first-failure receipts.

acceptance_tests.setup: Place valid-looking actions in assistant text while the structured tool channel is empty or malformed.
acceptance_tests.expected: Parse is REJECTED, dispatch is NOT_EXECUTED, dispatch_count is zero, and the pure mock state remains unchanged.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Any prose-derived action or state change falsifies the structured-channel authority boundary.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Future immutable PC3 fixtures, parse receipts, close receipts, and state comparison.

acceptance_tests.setup: Permute, duplicate, omit, or replace actions/opcodes and mutate pre/post state, measurements, transaction ID, rational reduction, denominator sign, and action order.
acceptance_tests.expected: Both validators independently recompute the ordered transition and score and reject every mismatch.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Any accepted semantic or order mismatch falsifies private transition provenance.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Future immutable PC4 relational fixture registry and dual replay receipts.

acceptance_tests.setup: Generate registered missing, duplicated, reordered, extra, cross-canary, non-immediate-parent, post-close, retry, recurrence, second-generation, second-accepted-call, and second-dispatch mutations.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only the two exact six-record legal paths validate; every other lifecycle rejects deterministically.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Any third path, recurrence, budget bypass, or ambiguous parent chain falsifies totality.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Future immutable PC5 lifecycle mutation registry and dual-validator receipts.

acceptance_tests.setup: Inject a synthetic crash before and after every create, write, fsync, parse, dispatch, close, validate, rename, and directory-fsync step.
acceptance_tests.expected: Recovery exposes either no committed artifact or one complete immutable valid artifact, never promotes a partial, and cannot execute an external effect because the mock is pure.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: A promoted partial, replaced commit, mutable commit, or ambiguous publication state falsifies durability.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Future immutable PC6 fault schedule, filesystem-state receipts, and dual-validator outputs.

acceptance_tests.setup: Coordinate and rehash downstream changes to schema plus response, response plus parser, parser plus dispatch, transition plus score, manifests plus payload, and close counts.
acceptance_tests.expected: The declarative oracle rejects every coordinated bundle unless it is a distinct pre-registered immutable fixture.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Acceptance based only on self-consistent checksums falsifies relational evidence binding.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Future immutable PC7 coordinated fixture registry, oracle decisions, and dual-validator receipts.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exercise exact-limit and one-over-limit cases for ledger bytes, line bytes, decoded aggregate and individual ByteStrings, depth, ByteString count, token IDs, action count, action-name length, integer range, and canonical base64.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every exact-limit registered valid fixture is accepted and every over-limit fixture rejects deterministically with E_RESOURCE or an earlier raw-byte error, without truncation.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Any unchecked allocation, truncation, nondeterministic limit, or accepted over-limit artifact falsifies the resource envelope.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Future immutable PC8 boundary fixture registry and dual-validator first-failure receipts.

acceptance_tests.setup: Mutate or omit each contract, schema, source, manifest, lock, platform, oracle, fixture, canary, validator, comparator, and registry hash bound by the canonical evidence receipt.
acceptance_tests.expected: No mutated or incomplete bundle is claim-eligible; the complete registered bundle validates under fresh independent review.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Any stale, missing, substituted, or circularly self-certified evidence accepted as claim-eligible falsifies the evidence gate.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Future canonical evidence receipt, PC9 mutation outputs, and fresh independent-review advisory.

human_boundary.decision_question: After two fresh interpretations, adversarial cross-critique, and concern-by-concern consensus, do you ratify these exact private-canary proposal and context bytes and exactly the three sorted CPU stub/mock scopes in scope_proposal.json, while retaining its five sorted forbidden scopes and requiring a new material change for any model, tokenizer, real tool or task, public projection, recurrence, parent, dream, sleep, LoRA, evaluation, benchmark, GPU, or broader claim?

execute PC1-PC9 or initialize an implementation supervisor
invoke a child stub, parser, mock transition, model, tokenizer, tool, environment, trainer, adapter, evaluator, benchmark, network service, or GPU
create an intake ratification, infer approval from model consensus, or treat generic compute permission as exact-byte approval
publish any plumbing, causal, behavioral, learning, memory, consolidation, secrecy, noninterference, real-tool, benchmark, or Experience Models claim
